method: W(3,7) point-transitivity reduction; projective F7^4 symplectic collinearity. Test cross-equality of 4-set syndromes with vertex0 present vs absent under fixed F2-linear 64-bit projection.
proof: If an even kernel word of weight <=8 exists, point transitivity places one support point at index 0; equal full syndromes follow for a balanced padded pair of distinct 4-subsets, one containing vertex 0 and the other excluding it. A linear projection must preserve equality. The exhaustive projected absence proves nonexistence, with no random-hash assumption.
limits: Weights 10 and 12 are not excluded. A fixed-pair MILP search timed out; its status is inconclusive.
